select aa.* from( SELECT a.ifprseq, a.ifprcategory, a.ifprtitle, a.ifprprice, a.ifprdiscout, a.ifprimfo, a.ifprorigin, a.ifprdeliveryimfo, a.ifprcomposition, a.ifprproductNumber, a.ifprinvetory, a.ifprtypeNy, a.ifprdelNy, a.ifpruseNy, a.ifprdate, a.ifprredate
ORDER BY a.ifprseq DESC ) aa limit #{rowNumToShow} offset #{startRnumForMysql}

SELECT a.ifprseq, a.ifprcategory, a.ifprtitle, a.ifprprice, a.ifprdiscout, a.ifprimfo, a.ifprorigin, a.ifprdeliveryimfo, a.ifprcomposition, a.ifprproductNumber, a.ifprinvetory, a.ifprtypeNy, a.ifprdelNy, a.ifpruseNy FROM product a WHERE 1=1 AND a.ifprseq = #{ifprseq} order by a.ifprseq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product( ifprcategory, ifprtitle, ifprprice, ifprdiscout, ifprimfo, ifprorigin, ifprdeliveryimfo, ifprcomposition, ifprproductNumber, ifprinvetory, ifprtypeNy, ifprdelNy, ifpruseNy, ifprdate ) values( #{ifprcategory}, #{ifprtitle}, #{ifprprice}, #{ifprdiscout}, #{ifprimfo}, #{ifprorigin}, #{ifprdeliveryimfo}, #{ifprcomposition}, #{ifprproductNumber}, 1, #{ifprtypeNy}, 0, 1, now() )
mapper.update: update product set ifprseq = #{ifprseq}, ifprcategory = #{ifprcategory}, ifprtitle = #{ifprtitle}, ifprprice = #{ifprprice}, ifprdiscout = #{ifprdiscout}, ifprimfo = #{ifprimfo}, ifprorigin = #{ifprorigin}, ifprdeliveryimfo = #{ifprdeliveryimfo}, ifprcomposition = #{ifprcomposition}, ifprproductNumber = #{ifprproductNumber}, ifprinvetory = 1, ifprtypeNy = #{ifprtypeNy}, ifprdelNy = 0, ifpruseNy = 1, ifprredate = now() where ifprseq = #{ifprseq}
update product set ifprdelNy = 1 where ifprseq=#{ifprseq}
